title: What If a Brand New Island Rose From the Sea? Surtsey Did

scenes.text: What if a brand new island rose out of the sea? In 1963, one did.
Fishermen off Iceland noticed an eruption on November 14th, 1963, from a vent about 130 meters underwater.
The island, Surtsey, kept growing for about three and a half years, until the eruptions stopped in June 1967.
It peaked at 2.6 square kilometers and rose 170 meters above the waves.
Life arrived fast. Sea rocket was found in 1965, and by 2008 scientists had counted 69 plant species.
Landing needs a permit, so nature colonizes it undisturbed, while waves have shrunk it to about 1.4 square kilometers.
